title: The ‘Ocarina of Time’ Remake Is Finally Here, but Why Does Link Look so Yassified?
gist: Nintendo's ground-up Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time has drawn fan backlash over a heavily stylized child Link, with suspicion that generative AI was involved; Nintendo confirmed using AMD FSR upscaling but declined to comment on generative AI in character design. The episode shows how anti-generative-AI sentiment among players has become a reputational risk for major publishers.

insights.speaker: Kimberly Rooney
insights.so_what: Publishers adopting generative AI to cut costs face consumer brand risk that can offset savings.

insights.so_what: AMD's upscaling tech is in Nintendo's flagship remake, while Nintendo's AI non-answer shows disclosure is becoming sensitive.

insights.so_what: Generative-AI upscaling has a recognizable 'look' that consumers now associate with negative aesthetics.

insights.speaker: Kimberly Rooney
insights.so_what: Nintendo is investing in full remakes of legacy IP as Switch 2 exclusives to drive hardware sales.
